summary.title: Q2 Engineering Team Sync — Apr 29 — AI Notetaker Summary
summary.content:
AI Notetaker — meeting summary
Meeting:  Q2 Engineering Team Sync — Apr 29
Host:     Maya Lin
Duration: 14:00 – 15:30 PT (90 min)
Attendees (full window): Maya Lin, Diana Park, Marcus Webb, Sarah Kim
Attendees (partial, left at 14:35 for new-hire onboarding): Alex Chen, Priya Nair

— Sprint & Gateway —
• 22 of 27 sprint tickets closed; 5 carryover are all on the API-gateway migration.
• Cutover is ~70% done. Translation-layer for legacy leaky-bucket -> new token-bucket rate limiter is drafted (Marcus); Sarah reviewing — merging tomorrow after Sarah's nit on uppercase legacy customer IDs lands.
• Staging cluster has been flaky since Monday; Maya will escalate with SRE leadership.

— Intern projects —
• Alex Chen: developer-portal docs revamp; auth-flow walkthrough done; Python and Node SDK quickstarts in progress (Sarah pairing). Python quickstart surfaced an SDK bug; fix filed.
• Priya Nair: metrics pipeline; Prometheus exporter shipped; Grafana dashboards next. Diana reviewing alert thresholds Thursday 11:00.

— Logistics —
• Cardinal renewal in talks; more next week.
• Eng all-hands moved to next Tuesday.
• Q2 perf-review self-assessments due May 15 (full-time); intern end-of-program review form to be sent to Priya.
• Design-system rewrite: no decision yet; more after Thursday exec sync.
• May on-call rotation: Marcus week 1, Sarah week 2, Diana week 3, week 4 TBD (asking data infra).
• Apr 18 incident retro: Marcus owns cache pre-warming; Sarah owns auth-call circuit breaker; Diana owns runbook update — target end of next week.

— Intern conversion (return-offer recommendations to Bob, due May 30) —
• Alex Chen: Working position is NO return offer. Diana and Sarah aligned that code contributions have been below bar (4 PRs in 8 weeks, 3 needed heavy rework; auth-flow code sample didn't run on first try; Sarah reports needing to walk through service-mesh routing she'd expect a returning intern to have absorbed by week 6). Maya will run a kind, structured exit conversation in early June with written feedback, and check whether Devrel docs has an opening as a separate path. Hold all communication until officially conveyed in early June; interns should hear from Maya directly, not through the grapevine.
• Priya Nair: Return offer YES at standard new-grad band. Diana, Sarah, Marcus all aligned — metrics pipeline work is solid, asks good questions, shipped Prometheus exporter independently and well-structured.

— Mid-year compensation (numbers from HR cycle, shared by Maya in this meeting) —
• Diana Park: 8% base increase plus one-time equity refresh (equity details in 1:1). Reflects leadership growth, gateway migration, new-hire onboarding ownership.
• Sarah Kim: 6% base, no equity refresh this cycle. On the slate for the senior-staff promotion case Maya will push in Q3; promo case discussion in Thursday 1:1.
• Marcus Webb: 3% base. Below team average. Driven by calibration committee weighting of the Q1 auth-incident postmortem (rate-limiter change identified as proximate cause). Maya pushed back during calibration; this is where it landed. Detailed conversation and path-forward planning in Thursday 1:1.

— Cardinal renewal & headcount risk (CONFIDENTIAL — closed-door portion) —
• Cardinal CFO is pushing for a ~30% contract reduction in renewal (range Bob expects: -25% to -35%). Renewal call is May 12.
• If lands at -30% or worse, Platform team is likely losing 2 of 4 open Q3 backfill reqs.
• Non-zero risk of touching existing headcount if cut is severe; contingency is to absorb via open reqs first.
• Maya: 'this does not leave the room — if this leaks before exec is ready to communicate it, it will be very bad for the company, for me, and for whoever leaks it.'

— Q3 prioritization scenarios —
• Full-headcount scenario: finish gateway migration → ship multi-region failover → start observability rewrite.
• Lose 2 reqs: drop observability rewrite; multi-region at minimum-viable scope.
• Lose more than 2: multi-region slips; team enters maintenance posture; aggressively kill legacy gateway path to cut on-call burden (Marcus's call).
• Cardinal-specific integrations: maintain through contracted SLA; consolidate after.
• Design-system rewrite: deferred to Q4 or later.
• Sarah's senior-staff promo case timing: discuss Thursday — Maya: case is about impact, not macro, but optics of timing matter.

— Action items —
• Marcus Webb — land rate-limiter translation-layer PR after Sarah's review (tomorrow).
• Sarah Kim — leave PR comment on uppercase-legacy-customer-ID key derivation; complete review.
• Maya Lin — bump SRE leadership on staging-cluster flakiness; send Priya the intern end-of-program review form.
• Diana Park — send May on-call rotation in Slack tonight; review Priya's Grafana alert thresholds Thursday 11:00.
• Marcus / Sarah / Diana — incident retro action items targeting end of next week.
• Maya Lin — submit intern return-offer recs to Bob by May 30; share Q3 planning doc with the four full-time attendees tomorrow.

— End of summary —
